vale_fc_001.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_001.text: Not another step. This is a restricted facility under Iron Covenant jurisdiction. State your purpose or clear the area. You have ten seconds.

choices.text: The signal broadcasting from inside — what is it?
[Speech 60] I'm not here to cause trouble. I just need access to the antenna.

vale_fc_002_leave.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_002_leave.text: Smart. Don't come back without Covenant clearance.

vale_fc_002_signal.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_002_signal.text: You don't know what you're asking about. That signal is Covenant business. Who sent you — Falk?

vale_fc_003_signal.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_003_signal.text: Give me a name or this conversation ends a different way. Your call.

vale_fc_002_speech_pass.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_002_speech_pass.text: ...I've heard that before. You're not Covenant, and this isn't a checkpoint you talk your way through. But you've got nerve. One minute at the outer perimeter — then you leave.

vale_fc_002_speech_fail.speaker: sgt_vale
vale_fc_002_speech_fail.text: Wrong answer. Clear the area. Now.
